item.title: Retatrutide Once Weekly for Treatment of Obstructive Sleep Apnea.
item.description: Background Retatrutide, an investigational triple agonist of glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide, glucagon-like peptide 1, and glucagon receptors, may be useful for treating obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). At 80 weeks, the mean changes in the AHI (hybrid-treatment estimand) with retatrutide in TRIUMPH-1-OSA were -22.9 (4 mg), -34.3 (9 mg), and -31.7 (12 mg) events per hour, versus -9.9 with placebo (difference vs. placebo, -13.0 [95% confidence interval {CI}, -23.0 to -3.0], -24.4 [95% CI, -34.1 to -14.7], and -21.9 [95% CI, -32.2 to -11.5], respectively).

item.title: Disease-free survival and overall survival after neoadjuvant immunotherapy in mismatch repair-deficient colon cancer in the Netherlands: results of the single-arm, multicentre, phase 2, NICHE-2 trial.
item.description: Background Neoadjuvant immune checkpoint blockade induces high pathological response rates in patients with locally advanced mismatch repair-deficient (dMMR) colon cancer, yet long-term survival outcomes have not been established. Previously, we reported safety (a primary endpoint) and pathological response (a secondary endpoint) data from the NICHE-2 trial. Here, we report the primary efficacy endpoint of 3-year disease-free survival and the exploratory endpoint of 5-year overall survival. Methods In this single-arm, multicentre, phase 2, NICHE-2 trial, patients with previously untreated, clinical stage 2 or 3, resectable dMMR colon cancer received a single dose of intravenous ipilimumab (1 mg per kg) on day 1, and two doses of intravenous nivolumab (3 mg per kg) on days 1 and 15, followed by surgery in one of the six participating hospitals in the Netherlands.

item.title: A Common CD36 Variant and the Genetic Landscape of Dilated Cardiomyopathy in Individuals of African Ancestry.
item.description: Importance Dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is a major cause of heart failure that disproportionately affects individuals of predominantly African ancestry, among whom familial clustering of disease is more pronounced relative to those of predominantly European ancestry. Truncating variants in TTN, which encodes the sarcomeric protein titin, are the most common established monogenic cause of DCM. A common CD36 nonsense variant enriched among individuals of African ancestry has also been shown to account for a substantial burden of DCM. Objective To compare the contribution of a CD36 nonsense variant to DCM risk with that of truncating variants in TTN and pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in other established genes for DCM.

item.title: Determinants of response to CAR T cell therapy in a multicenter, multi-trial cohort analysis of patients with lymphoma
item.description: In patients with non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL) treated with chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy, factors associated with efficacy overlap with prognostic biomarkers. A high proportion of naive-like (CCR7+CD45RA+) T cells was the most significant feature associated with prolonged progression-free survival (PFS; hazard ratio = 0.46, 95% confidence interval: 0.31−0.68, P = 9.8 × 10−5, high versus low naive-like T cell groups) without impacting safety. In multivariate models, the naive-like phenotype outperformed clinicopathologic features such as inflammatory markers and tumor burden, remaining significant after adjusting for product expansion. The key findings were validated in an independent cohort of 203 patients treated with axi-cel-based therapy or brexucabtagene autoleucel.

item.title: 医疗保险计划； 2026 年《综合拨款法》第 6219、6220 和 6224 条的实施 (CMS-4214-P)
item.description: 医疗保险计划；实施 2026 年综合拨款法 (CMS-4214-P) 第 6219、6220 和 6224 条 背景 2026 年 10 月 16 日，医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心 (CMS) 发布了一项拟议规则，以实施 2026 年综合拨款法的关键部分，包括第 6220 条（要求加强和(REAL) 医疗服务提供者法案的准确列表）和第 6224 条（现代化并确保药房福利经理责任）。要求增强和准确的（真实）健康提供者法案列表（第 6220 条）：CMS 提议编纂法规以实施真实健康提供者法案，该法案从 2028 年合同年开始为 MA 组织制定了新的提供者目录验证和准确性要求。

item.title: UK government confirms indefinite EU CE mark recognition
item.description: The decision effectively shelves post-Brexit plans that would have required CE-marked medtech to secure a separate tag for the UK market by 2030.

item.title: Exchange Pre-Eligibility Verification Proposed Rule (CMS 9873-P)
item.description: Exchange Pre-Eligibility Verification Proposed Rule (CMS 9873-P) Introduction Consistent with the President’s goal to prevent waste, fraud, and abuse, today the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), through the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), issued the Exchange Pre-Eligibility Verification Notice of Proposed Rulemaking. This rule would align Exchange eligibility and verification regulations with new requirements specified under the Working Families Tax Cuts (WFTC) legislation (P.L. 119-21). The WFTC legislation amended the Internal Revenue Code to establish new eligibility requirements for the premium tax credit (PTC).

item.title: Acetic acid chromoendoscopy for detection of neoplastic Barrett's oesophagus: stepped wedge cluster randomised controlled trial (ACID-trial).
item.description: Objective To assess the added value of acetic acid chromoendoscopy (AAC) for the detection of dysplasia and oesophageal adenocarcinoma during Barrett's oesophagus surveillance endoscopies. AAC use did not increase the neoplasia detection rate (7.4% (50/679) with AAC versus 7.1% (113/1588) without AAC; odds ratio 0.97, 95% confidence interval 0.65 to 1.44; adjusted for calendar time and Barrett's oesophagus length).

item.title: 急性肾损伤的间歇或连续肾脏替代治疗。
item.description: 背景 危重患者急性肾损伤的首选肾脏替代治疗方法仍不确定。到第 90 天，间歇组有 203 名患者（78.1%）发生了重大肾脏不良事件，连续组有 197 名患者（71.6%）发生了重大肾脏不良事件（调整后的绝对风险差异，6.28 个百分点；95% 置信区间 [CI]，-1.22 至 13.79）。

item.title: Projected Effect of 2026 Federal Changes to the Childhood Immunization Schedule on Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infections in the United States.
item.description: Background The United States recently proposed changes to the recommendations for childhood hepatitis B virus (HBV) vaccination. Objective To project the effect of vaccine policy changes, if fully implemented, on chronic HBV infections. Design Markov cohort state transition model of perinatal and childhood HBV infection. Data sources Published data on maternal HBV prevalence (0.4%) and hepatitis B surface antigen testing (99.5% sensitivity), childhood vaccine completion (universal birth-dose strategy: 91.1%; deferred strategy: 87.1%; shared decision-making strategy: 50.0%), and age-stratified risk for chronic HBV infection. Target population One-year birth cohort of U.S.-born infants ( n = 3.6 million). Time horizon 20 years. Intervention Universal birth-dose vaccination, deferred (2-month) vaccination, and vaccination through shared decision making.

item.title: 术中多巴酚丁胺加去甲肾上腺素预防感染性休克术后急性肾损伤：一项随机临床试验。
item.description: 重要性 基于极低确定性的证据，国际指南建议使用多巴酚丁胺来治疗成人感染性休克和伴有持续低灌注的心功能障碍。缺乏关于术中多巴酚丁胺联合去甲肾上腺素与去甲肾上腺素对接受手术感染性休克患者术后感染源控制的影响的随机试验。目的 确定术中多巴酚丁胺联合去甲肾上腺素是否可以减轻接受手术源控制的感染性休克患者术后 7 天内的急性肾损伤（AKI）。设计、设置和参与者 这项在中国 39 家三级医院开展的随机、开放标签临床试验纳入了 2024 年 6 月至 2025 年 8 月期间接受手术源控制的感染性休克成人患者。随访于 2025 年 11 月 15 日结束。

item.title: FDA Approves First-of-Its-Kind Chronic Hepatitis B Treatment
item.description: FDA today approved Hibsago (bepirovirsen) injection, in combination with existing antiviral therapy, to treat chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in certain adults without cirrhosis.

item.title: Human oversight of erroneous clinical AI and decision support a systematic review and meta analysis
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly supports clinical decisions, but human oversight is protective only if clinicians recognize and resist erroneous output. We systematically reviewed controlled and real-world studies of clinician responses to incorrect automated advice. Forty-six reports represented 41 independent cohort clusters, including 40 core cohorts. Across three adjusted cohorts, clinician correctness was substantially higher with correct than incorrect automated advice (pooled OR 10.19, 95% CI 7.43–13.98; I² = 0%); a ≥ 2020 sensitivity analysis was similar but imprecise (OR 9.22, 95% CI 2.06–41.13). In four heterogeneous real-world computerized ECG studies, 26.6% of erroneous interpretations were not corrected or recognized (95% CI 6.4–65.6%; I² = 95.8%).

item.title: 未经胰岛素治疗的 2 型糖尿病的连续血糖监测。
item.description: 背景 连续血糖监测 (CGM) 已被证明对 1 型糖尿病患者和其他接受胰岛素治疗的 2 型糖尿病患者有益，但其在治疗未接受胰岛素治疗的 2 型糖尿病患者中的作用还需要进一步研究。 CGM 组的平均 (±SD) 糖化血红蛋白水平从基线时的 8.8±1.3% 降至 26 周时的 7.2±1.1%，常规护理组从 8.7±1.2% 降至 8.0±1.4%（调整后的平均差，-0.9 个百分点；95% 置信区间 [CI]，-1.1 至 -0.6；P < 0.001）。

item.title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Cardiovascular Conditions in Medicare Advantage In-Home Health Risk Assessments.
item.description: Background Medicare Advantage insurers conduct in-home health risk assessments (HRAs) to identify high-risk patients and facilitate appropriate care. Critics argue this practice increases risk-adjusted payments without improving quality. Comprehensive data on use of in-home HRAs and downstream treatment are lacking. Objective To examine trends in cardiovascular conditions diagnosed during in-home HRAs, characteristics associated with HRA-based diagnoses, and treatment rates after diagnoses. Design Cohort study. Setting Population-based. Participants Medicare Advantage beneficiaries. Measurements Using 100% Medicare claims, trends in the proportion of cardiovascular conditions diagnosed during in-home HRAs (vs. facility-based visits) were examined.

item.title: Lymph node-targeted, mKRAS-specific amphiphile vaccine in pancreatic cancer: the randomized phase 2 AMPLIFY-7P trial
item.description: Camupepimut (ELI-002 7P) drives mutated KRAS (mKRAS)-specific T cell responses that correlated with disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS) in patients with mKRAS pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PDAC) in the phase 1 AMPLIFY-201 trial. Post hoc multivariate Cox regression analysis of DFS indicated an improved outcome for camupepimut (adjusted HR 0.47, P = 0.0086), a worse outcome for stage III disease (adjusted HR 2.29, P = 0.0127), an elevated baseline CA19-9 (adjusted HR 3.16, P < 0.0001) and baseline circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) positivity (adjusted HR 5.99, P < 0.0001). In camupepimut-treated patients, mKRAS-specific T cell response >9.17-fold over baseline (82.2%, 74/90) correlated with improved DFS (HR 0.22, P < 0.0001), with the median DFS not reached versus 6.08 months for above and below 9.17-fold, respectively.

item.title: 机械通气危重成年患者的液体治疗。
item.description: 重要性 液体治疗在重症监护病房 (ICU) 中无处不在，但存在风险，特别是对于机械通气患者。目前全球在剂量、适应症和类型方面的实践尚不清楚。目的 描述 ICU 成人机械通气液体操作的特点。设计、设置和参与者 2024 年 4 月至 2025 年 7 月期间在六大洲 41 个国家的 206 个 ICU 中进行的国际前瞻性观察队列研究。入ICU后3天内连续接受有创机械通气且通气24小时或更长时间的成年患者。排除标准是年龄小于 16 岁并且从另一个 ICU 转入机械通气。暴露 插管后的液体量、适应症和类型。主要结局和指标 主要指标包括（1）插管后 7 天内的总输液量和每日液体平衡；

item.title: FDA 批准免疫疗法可让某些直肠癌患者避免化疗、放疗和手术
item.description: 美国食品和药物管理局今天加速批准免疫疗法 Jemperli (dostarlimab-gxly) 的新用途，该疗法可能使一些局部晚期直肠癌患者避免对其日常生活产生持久影响的常见治疗。

item.title: Individualized Cardiac Index-Guided Hemodynamic Therapy in High-Risk Patients Undergoing Elective Major Abdominal Surgery: The PELICAN Randomized Clinical Trial.
item.description: Importance It remains unclear if intraoperative hemodynamic therapy should be guided by cardiac index. Objective To evaluate whether individualized cardiac index-guided hemodynamic therapy vs routine hemodynamic therapy improves outcomes in high-risk patients undergoing elective major abdominal surgery. Design, setting, and participants This multicenter, single-blind, superiority randomized clinical trial enrolled high-risk patients undergoing elective major abdominal surgery between October 8, 2023, and October 25, 2025, at 12 university medical centers in Austria, the Czech Republic, Denmark, Germany, and Spain. The date of last follow-up was January 15, 2026. Interventions Patients were randomized to individualized cardiac index-guided hemodynamic therapy targeting the patient's preoperative resting cardiac index vs routine hemodynamic therapy (with blinded cardiac index monitoring).

item.title: Childhood Cancer Risk After Assisted Reproductive Technology.
item.description: Importance Childhood cancer risk after assisted reproductive technology (ART) remains uncertain, particularly by procedure and cancer type. Objective To examine associations between ART and childhood cancer overall and by ART modality and cancer type. Design, setting, and population Nationwide Danish cohort of 1 086 136 live-born children from 1996 to 2012, of whom 37 228 (3.4%) were conceived using ART, with follow-up through 2023. Exposures Maternal ART, classified as in vitro fertilization (IVF), intracytoplasmic sperm injection, or frozen embryo transfer. Main outcomes and measures Incident childhood cancer. Cox proportional hazards models estimated hazard ratios (HRs); Poisson models estimated incidence rates. Non-ART births were the primary reference; secondary analyses used children of women with a history of infertility and children conceived using IVF as reference groups.

item.title: 加压素起始阈值对感染性休克死亡率的影响：VASSPR 集群交叉随机策略试验。
item.description: 重要性 对于感染性休克患者，开始使用第二种血管升压药的最佳升压药剂量尚不确定。干预 医院层面实施感染性休克管理策略，建议当其他血管升压药的总剂量达到去甲肾上腺素或等效物 0.1 µg/kg/min 或等效物（较低阈值策略）或其他血管升压药的总剂量达到去甲肾上腺素或等效物 0.4 µg/kg/min 时（较高阈值策略），开始固定剂量加压素。
